title: 42 Folds to the Moon
premise: The narrator claims that folding an ordinary sheet of paper 42 times would make a stack that reaches the Moon. No characters appear. A 0.1 mm sheet doubles with every fold and passes landmarks: about 10 cm at 10 folds, the Statue of Liberty at 20, Everest at 27 and the edge of space at 30. The twist comes at 41 folds, when the stack is about 220,000 km and still only halfway there. The 42nd fold doubles it to about 440,000 km, past the Moon at about 384,000 km.
